title: File:ThaPaeWalkingStreet1.jpg
author: LannaPhoto
description: At the east of Chiang Mai city there is a two-layer city wall. There is Ta Pae Road connected with the Ping River to the city passing the external layer of the Ta Pae city gate at Saen Farng Temple direct to the internal layer of Ta Pae city gate. Ta Pae road used to be an economic area so there are several shops and temples located along both sides of the road such as Bupparam Temple, Saen Farng
